reason: The 16-bit tip counter wraps after 65,535, which is integer overflow rather than any listed defect.
SpecimenLabel.contact again calls Trim() on a null optional phone, the exact implementation and cause fixed in #5411.
The missing first working day causes a full-day pay shortfall, unlike the floating-point deduction rounding in #823.
Bluetooth is enabled and failures are confined to v3 locks, ruling out the Bluetooth-off check defect in #2401.
Accented names become the same mojibake only in outgoing emails, matching the email encoding defect in #509.
Uninterrupted 25-fps films drift five minutes over two hours on both web and TV, matching #3508 rather than the pause-specific TV defect.
A fast successful export omits every invoice on the final date, indicating a date-boundary defect absent from the fixed bugs.
BillComposer.total again rounds each charge before summing, exactly the code path and rounding cause fixed in #5211.
Alerts trigger promptly and only iOS delivery is delayed with priority 5, unlike the old trigger backlog or invalid push certificate.
Loading an entire large video for its thumbnail exhausts memory, unlike the missing-profile null reference in #1017.
The clock-change weekend misclassifies a retained late-evening session into the next day, matching the timezone defect in #618.
Resetting immediately after 65,535 tips identifies unsigned 16-bit overflow, which none of the fixed bugs covers.
Counting 29 instead of 30 working days loses a full day of pay, a different cause from #823 rounding deductions.
StationCalendar.day again takes the UTC date without station-timezone conversion, exactly the defect fixed in #5711.
The failing AdjustmentBatch.total is an independent implementation outside #5211, while the patched BillComposer.total remains correct.
Hard-coded dark-mode colors cause insufficient contrast, which is unrelated to the listed warehouse defects.
The export completes quickly but excludes the last day of August, a new date-range boundary issue rather than #2629 timeout.
René and Zoë become mojibake only in email, reproducing #509 encoding corruption rather than duplicate delivery.
The identical cross-device drift on uninterrupted 25-fps films matches the frame-rate conversion failure in #3508.
Omission of all August 31 invoices despite a three-second successful export indicates an unlisted date-boundary defect.
Duplicate executions of the same dose reminder following reboot match the duplicate alarm scheduling defect in #2143.
Five minutes of drift over two uninterrupted hours on both web and TV for 25-fps films identifies #3508 frame-rate conversion.
Add-on bill totals with three decimal places rejected by the payment link reproduce #2222 floating-point billing errors.
Unlock fails for v3 locks despite enabled Bluetooth and successful unlocks elsewhere, unlike the Bluetooth-off defect in #2401.
The omitted joining day and whole-day salary difference indicate a new counting boundary issue rather than deduction rounding.
The value 1,717 is approximately 5.3 times 18 twice, and the changed shared UnitConverter is the helper fixed in #2522.
A late-evening session assigned to Sunday after daylight saving ends matches #618 timezone-based day misclassification.
Correct in-app names become accented-character mojibake in email, the same encoding failure described in #509.
The same alarm executes twice after phone restart, matching #2143 duplicate recreation of dose reminders.
The logs show submission completes before pending autosave succeeds, directly reproducing the race fixed in #2304.
The outgoing messages garble accented names while the app displays them correctly, matching #509 email encoding corruption.
One free share per existing share is a 1:1 bonus issue whose unadjusted cost basis reproduces #3374.
Prompt alert triggering with delayed iOS-only priority-5 pushes indicates a delivery-priority issue absent from the fixed bugs.
The unreadable badge comes from hard-coded dark-mode colors, an unlisted contrast defect.
